This is based on the docs only, mainly `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md`, which uses this exact feature as its example. I didn't open any code files, so line numbers come from the docs' anchors.

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` next to the other `*Body` types (around `ShopTransactionBody:159`). Add a cost constant such as `INN_REST_COST`. The cost is a design choice, so pick a flat price or one that scales with level. |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Export `restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with `POST /`. Validate the body and call `getCharacter`. Return an error if `gold < cost`, or if HP is already full so the player isn't charged for nothing. Then call `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`services/character.ts:94`, which only accepts whitelisted fields). Return `{ updatedCharacter }`. Optionally add an `adventure_log` insert, and `appendHistory` plus `saveSession`, following `routes/action.ts`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts` (lines 41-48) | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. |
| `worker/src/services/*.ts` | Only needed if other routes share the logic. Otherwise keep it in the route. |

I'd have the route reject a rest while the session's `combatState` is active. The docs show that state lives in the KV session (`CombatState`/`SessionData`), so the route would need to load the session to check it.

No migration is needed, because `characters.hp`, `max_hp` and `gold` already exist.

## Frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse { updatedCharacter: Character }` interface mirroring the Worker response. Nothing enforces that the two copies match. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)` that POSTs to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `restAtInn()` handler. It calls `GameApiService.rest`, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`, then pushes a system or narrative entry. On error, show `err.error.error`. Disable it while `inCombat()` is true. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn" button, with the cost in its label, near the Inventory button (`:9`). |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy. |

`character-state.service.ts` needs no change, since `setCharacter` already updates HP and gold.

## Docs to update in the same change
- Create `worker/src/routes/rest.md`, and update the docs beside the changed files: `types/index.md`, `worker/src/index.md` (route mounts table), `game-api.service.md`, `game.models.md` and `game-console.component.md`.
- Update the `code.md` index, then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`.
- Update the API spec in `docs/PRD.md` §9. Add a flow note in `docs/flows/inventory.md`, which covers shops.
